parts.name: Root
parts.description: The stateful table container. Renders an interactive grid over native table markup and manages focus, selection, sorting, column widths, and column visibility.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Whether rows can be selected: 'none', 'single', or 'multiple'.

props.name: selectionBehavior
props.description: 'toggle' allows deselecting an already selected row; 'replace' keeps selected rows selected when pressed again.

props.name: disabledBehavior
props.description: 'all' makes disabled rows fully non-interactive; 'selection' only blocks selection.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: Prevents the user from deselecting the last selected row.

props.name: hiddenColumns
props.description: Controlled list of hidden column ids. Bindable. Hidden columns keep their registered widths so they can be restored.

props.name: defaultHiddenColumns
props.description: Initially hidden column ids when uncontrolled.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: Controlled set of selected row ids. Bindable.

props.name: defaultSelectedKeys
props.description: Initially selected row ids when uncontrolled.

props.name: sortDescriptor
props.description: Controlled sort state (column id and direction). Bindable. Setting it back to undefined clears the sort.

props.name: defaultSortDescriptor
props.description: Initial sort state when uncontrolled.

props.name: columnWidths
props.description: Controlled column widths keyed by column id. Bindable. Width specs can be px, '%', or 'fr'.

props.name: defaultColumnWidths
props.description: Initial column widths when uncontrolled; the user can still resize them.

props.name: ssrMinTableWidth
props.description:
Width (in px) the table reserves through `min-width` during server
rendering, before its columns have registered their own widths.

On the server the `<table>` element is serialized before the column
children run their registration, so the table cannot know its own
minimum width yet and renders at the container width. On hydration the
resolved column widths can push the table wider, producing a layout
shift. Set this to the sum of the columns' resolved widths to reserve
that space up-front and avoid the jump. Ignored once the real columns
register on the client.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Ids of rows that stay rendered but are affected by `disabledBehavior`.

props.name: onRowAction
props.description: Called with the row id when a row is activated.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called when the row selection changes.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when the sort state changes; receives undefined when sorting is cleared.

props.name: onColumnWidthsChange
props.description: Called when column widths change.

props.name: onHiddenColumnsChange
props.description: Called when column visibility changes.

props.name: onColumnResizeStart
props.description: Called with the column id when a resize interaction starts.

props.name: onColumnResizeEnd
props.description: Called with the final width map when a resize interaction ends.

props.name: children
props.description: The header, body, and footer parts.

props.name: context
props.description: Bindable handle exposing the table state for advanced composition.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered table element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled-behavior
dataAttributes.description: The configured disabled behavior ('all' | 'selection').

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus inside the table should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the table.

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-behavior
dataAttributes.description: The configured selection behavior ('toggle' | 'replace').

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-mode
dataAttributes.description: The configured selection mode ('none' | 'single' | 'multiple').

dataAttributes.name: data-table-column-resizer
dataAttributes.description: Marks resize handles inside the table; the root switches to a fixed table layout when any are present.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-implicit-width
dataAttributes.description: Present on a column's col element while it still uses an implicit width (before widths are materialized by a resize).

parts.name: Column
parts.description: Metadata-only wrapper for a column. Renders no DOM itself; it registers the column and should wrap a single Table.ColumnHeaderCell.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique column id used for sorting, visibility, and width state.

props.name: rowHeader
props.description: Makes this column's body cells render as rowheader.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Spoken column label used for polite sort announcements when it should differ from the column id.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width (px, '%', or 'fr'). Fixed-width columns ignore resize attempts even if a resizer is composed.

props.name: defaultWidth
props.description: Initial uncontrolled width that can still be resized by the user.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Minimum width in px the column can shrink to.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width in px the column can grow to.

props.name: pin
props.description:
Freezes the column against the horizontal scroll edge: `'left'` sticks it to
the start, `'right'` to the end. Multiple columns can pin to the same side —
they stack in document order and the table computes each one's offset from
the resolved widths of the columns already pinned ahead of it.

props.name: children
props.description: The single Table.ColumnHeaderCell this column wraps.

parts.name: Header
parts.description: The table head section containing the header row.

props.name: children
props.description: The header row with its columns.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-header
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the header element.

parts.name: Body
parts.description: The table body section. Renders the data rows and hosts the empty state.

props.name: items
props.description: Row data array for items mode; each item renders through the children snippet.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description: Virtualization config for rendering only visible rows in large datasets.

props.name: empty
props.description: Snippet rendered when items is empty.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Present while the body has no rows.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-body
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the body element.

dataAttributes.name: data-virtual-spacer
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the top or bottom spacer rows used by virtualization ('top' | 'bottom').

parts.name: EmptyState
parts.description: A placeholder row shown inside the body while the table has no rows. Use it instead of conditionally rendering freeform body content.

props.name: children
props.description: The empty state content.

dataAttributes.name: data-empty
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the empty state row.

parts.name: Footer
parts.description: The table foot section, for summary rows.

props.name: children
props.description: The footer row(s).

dataAttributes.name: data-table-footer
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the footer element.

parts.name: Row
parts.description: A table row. Body rows take an id to participate in selection, focus navigation, and row actions.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique row id used for selection, disabled state, and row actions.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables this row according to the root's `disabledBehavior`.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Plain-text description of the row for assistive announcements.

props.name: children
props.description: The row's cells.

dataAttributes.name: data-actionable
dataAttributes.description: Present when activating the row triggers a row action.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the row is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the row itself is focused and focus should be visibly indicated.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while an element inside the row has visibly indicated focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the row.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the row itself has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the row is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the row cannot be selected.

parts.name: ColumnHeaderCell
parts.description: A header cell. Remains the roving-focus target for its column even when it contains a sort trigger or resizer.

props.name: children
props.description: The header cell content, optionally including Table.SortTrigger and Table.ColumnResizer.

dataAttributes.name: data-column-index
dataAttributes.description: Index of the cell's column among visible columns.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell is focused and focus should be visibly indicated.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while an element inside the cell has visibly indicated focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus is inside the cell.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pin-edge
dataAttributes.description: The edge the owning column is pinned to ('left' | 'right').

dataAttributes.name: data-pinned
dataAttributes.description: Present when the owning column is pinned.

dataAttributes.name: data-sort-direction
dataAttributes.description: The active sort direction while this column is sorted ('ascending' | 'descending').

dataAttributes.name: data-sortable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the owning column is sortable.

parts.name: SortTrigger
parts.description: The explicit opt-in button for sorting. Rendering it inside a header cell makes the owning column sortable and toggles the root's sortDescriptor.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger content; can consume a `sortDirection` render state for stateful labels or visuals.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-sort-direction
dataAttributes.description: The active sort direction while the owning column is sorted ('ascending' | 'descending').

dataAttributes.name: data-sorted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the owning column is the active sort column.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-sort-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the sort trigger element.

parts.name: ColumnResizer
parts.description: A keyboard-accessible resize handle. Rendering it inside a header cell makes the owning column resizable.

props.name: step
props.description: Width change in px per arrow key press in keyboard resize mode.

props.name: shiftStep
props.description: Width change in px per arrow key press while holding Shift.

props.name: children
props.description: The visual handle content.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the handle is focused and focus should be visibly indicated.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the handle has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-resizable
dataAttributes.description: Present when the owning column can currently be resized.

dataAttributes.name: data-resizable-direction
dataAttributes.description: The direction the handle resizes toward (currently always 'right').

dataAttributes.name: data-resizing
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer or keyboard resize is in progress.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-column-resizer
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the resize handle element.

dataAttributes.name: data-testid
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the hidden resize status live region ('column-resize-status'); not a styling target.

parts.name: Checkbox
parts.description: An explicit selection control inside header or body cells. Auto-hides in header cells unless selectionMode is 'multiple', and everywhere when selection is disabled.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the rendered checkbox. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: title
props.description: Native tooltip text for the checkbox.

props.name: children
props.description: The checkbox content, typically a `Table.CheckboxIndicator`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label when no visible label is associated.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the checkbox.

dataAttributes.name: data-table-checkbox
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the checkbox element.

parts.name: CheckboxIndicator
parts.description: The visual mark inside a table checkbox, composing custom affordances for checked and indeterminate states.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keep the indicator mounted even while the checkbox is unchecked.

props.name: children
props.description: The indicator content, typically a check or minus icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-checkbox-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is indeterminate (partial selection).

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is actively pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is unchecked (with `forceMount`).

parts.name: Cell
parts.description: A body or footer cell participating in grid keyboard navigation. First-column body cells render as rowheader when their column has rowHeader.

dataAttributes.name: data-actionable
dataAttributes.description: Present when activating the cell's row triggers a row action.

dataAttributes.name: data-column-index
dataAttributes.description: Index of the cell's column among visible columns.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the cell's row is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell is focused and focus should be visibly indicated.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pin-edge
dataAttributes.description: The edge the owning column is pinned to ('left' | 'right').

dataAttributes.name: data-pinned
dataAttributes.description: Present when the owning column is pinned.

dataAttributes.name: data-row-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell's row is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the cell's row cannot be selected.

parts.name: InteractiveCell
parts.description: A body cell for content with its own focusable controls. The cell keeps grid keyboard navigation while focus is on it; focused descendants own their interactions.

dataAttributes.name: data-actionable
dataAttributes.description: Present when activating the cell's row triggers a row action.

dataAttributes.name: data-column-index
dataAttributes.description: Index of the cell's column among visible columns.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the cell's row is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell is focused and focus should be visibly indicated.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-pin-edge
dataAttributes.description: The edge the owning column is pinned to ('left' | 'right').

dataAttributes.name: data-pinned
dataAttributes.description: Present when the owning column is pinned.

dataAttributes.name: data-row-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell's row is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-selection-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the cell's row cannot be selected.
